facts: The .fnt files that differ only in bytes (same keys, texts, priorities, windows and voice ids) differ in the unread 4*count tail.
Priorities, windows and voice ids are identical between PAL and NTSC-U in every record both have: a NTSC-U .fnt does not change subtitle timing.
The glyph rectangles of every differing .met differ: PAL re-packed the sheets. A .met must travel with the .txd of the same region.

A mod that replaces only *_EN files changes only the English text; with FR/GE/IT/SP/JP (or the Hungarian slot, which serves English files under its own text) selected, the game reads the other languages' own files.
